ordex._comment_cancel_buffer: Hold a resting order until fair drifts cancel_buffer*place_thresh from its rung before re-quoting. Keep it GENEROUS on thin/quiet HL books so we don't churn place/cancel (L1 quota) on quotes that rarely fill; a buffer wider than the rung spacing sparsifies the ladder.
ordex._comment_thresh: All thresholds are ABSOLUTE probability points (0-1), not relative: e.g. place_thresh 0.02 = quote 2 cents off fair; cross_thresh 0.1 = only cross when the book is >10 cents mispriced vs fair.
ordex._comment_cross: Crossing (taking): IOC into the HL book when it's mispriced vs fair.
ordex._comment_capital: startup_complete_sets is the capitalization target the gateway mints to (defaults to max_pos if omitted); the gateway blocks orders for the ticker until it holds enough complete sets.
